name: gongwen-format
title_zh: 仿宋三号、28磅行距，公文排版一次到位
tagline_zh: 写完标书技术方案，最怕格式被退回重排。它把仿宋GB2312三号、28磅固定行距、页边距和版心网格一次套全。
tagline_en: Stop getting your proposal sent back for formatting. It applies FangSong GB2312 size 3, 28pt fixed leading.
desc_en: Use when writing any formal Chinese document (标书、技术方案、技术文档、汇报材料、公文、工作报告) — applies the unified typesetting standard: 仿宋GB2312 三号 body, 28磅 fixed line spacing, plus fonts, margins, page grid, and binding. Complements chinese-technical-writing, which covers content-level rules.
why_zh: 不是给个模板让你自己调，而是把公文排版标准写死成规则：字体、字号、行距、页边距、版心、装订线一次落到位。
why_en: Not a template you tweak yourself — the official typesetting standard is hard-coded: font, size, leading, margins, page grid and.
limit_zh: 只管版式不管内容，措辞和结构得靠 chinese-technical-writing。
limit_en: Formatting only, not content — pair it with chinese-technical-writing. It assumes the FangSong GB2312 size-3 national standard; other house.
title_en: Official Chinese document typesetting, done in one pass
